    rw [add_comm, sub_sub_cancel]
    exact h.Lnorm x⟩

            rw [h₁.Lnorm, h₃.Lnorm, h₃.Lnorm ((1 - P) • R • x), sub_smul 1 P, one_smul, smul_sub,
